evidence_boundary: M15 Thin Skill Adapter adds one self-contained Agent Skills artifact at skills/doctorcode/SKILL.md. It is orchestration-only: audit, bounded context, pre-repair contract capture, minimal repair guidance, and deterministic verify remain implemented exclusively by the DoctorCode CLI/core.
